body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves the record detail experience by enhancing semantic visual cues (status colors), making related lists more space-efficient (collapsible + default pagination size), and improving table usability on narrow viewports (non-wrapping headers + stronger row hover).

**Changes:**
- Expanded select badge auto-coloring to cover common status values via a normalized semantic color map.
- Added collapsible behavior to `RelatedList` and updated related rendering in `DetailView` to default to a 5-row page size.
- Improved `DataTable` header responsiveness and row hover styling; updated/added tests for the new behaviors.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx | Adds collapsible card behavior and replaces count text with a Badge in the header. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Passes `collapsible` and a default related-list `pageSize` to all `RelatedList` instances. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Prevents header wrapping via `truncate` styling and strengthens row hover background. |
| packages/fields/src/index.tsx | Replaces priority-only mapping with a broader semantic color map and normalizes lookup keys. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.test.tsx | Updates record count assertions and adds tests for collapsible behavior. |
</details>

`collapsed` state is initialized from `defaultCollapsed` even when `collapsible` is false. If a consumer passes `defaultCollapsed` without `collapsible`, the content will be hidden with no way to expand (since the header click handler isn’t wired). Initialize `collapsed` as `collapsible && defaultCollapsed` (and consider syncing if these props change).

The collapsible header is implemented via `onClick` on `CardHeader`, but it’s not keyboard-accessible (no role/tabIndex/Enter+Space handling) and screen readers won’t announce it as interactive. Consider rendering an actual button for the toggle, or add `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, and an `onKeyDown` handler for Enter/Space.

The record-count `aria-label` is hard-coded as `${relatedData.length} records`, which (a) isn’t localized via `t(...)` like the rest of the header and (b) is grammatically incorrect for the singular case. Consider reusing the existing `detail.relatedRecordOne` / `detail.relatedRecords` translations for the accessible label (and/or include an `sr-only` text node).
```suggestion
            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className="text-xs font-normal"
              aria-label={
                relatedData.length === 1
                  ? t('detail.relatedRecordOne')
                  : t('detail.relatedRecords', { count: relatedData.length })
              }
            >
```

`truncate` won’t reliably apply on a plain `<span>` because overflow/ellipsis don’t take effect on inline elements, and in a flex row you typically need `min-w-0` on the flex item/container for truncation to work. Consider making the header text element `block`/`inline-block` and ensuring its flex parent/itself has `min-w-0` so the ellipsis actually appears on narrow viewports.

The updated record-count tests assert `getByText('0'|'1'|'2')`, which is brittle because those numbers can also appear elsewhere in the rendered table (e.g., row IDs/values, pagination text). Prefer querying the Badge via its accessible name (e.g., `getByLabelText(...)`) or scoping the search to the header to avoid false positives.
